reason: The offline alarm and the physical button answer my first worry, and the refund is fair, but I would be paying EUR 120 up front for something that does not exist as a shipped product yet. My phone alarm already works for free and I would still be tempted to bring the phone to bed.
objection: It is a pre-order from a brand-new company, so I am paying now for a device nobody has reviewed. I do not know if the sleep and snoring estimate is any good, or if the alarm is reliable enough that I will not oversleep on a work morning.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews from people who have used it for a few weeks, or a shipped unit I could see working, ideally at around EUR 90 to 100.
